title: Loose weave
text: Loose weave. Liked the style of the towel the problem was the weave was to loose and was snagging on the dishes.

product_metadata.title: Mordimy 100% Cotton Waffle Weave Plaid Dish Cloths, 12 x 12 Inches, Super Soft and Absorbent Quick Drying Buffalo Check Dish Rags for Kitchen, 6-Pack, Black & Grey
features: ✔ 100% Cotton: Mordimy dish cloths for washing dishes are made of 100% pure premium cotton, soft and eco-friendly, with waffle weave, making them more durable and have better washing ability.
✔ Super Absorbent: The classic honeycomb check design with buffalo check pattern makes our dish rags have better absorbency than normal kitchen rags while can match most of kitchen furniture.
✔ Wide Application: Mordimy kitchen washcloths are finely woven, soft and low-lint, can be used to wash cups, dishes, cookware, stovetops or other kitchen items.
✔ Easy Care: The dishcloths for kitchen are machine washable with cold water on a gentle cycle. Tumble dry low to minimize shrinkage, no bleach, no tearing. Wash before first use.
✔ Value Pack: Includes 6 cotton dish cloths, size 12 x 12 inches, regular life expectancy of six months and even more, there are also a variety of colors for you to choose from.
